thought.text: The form likely uses `user[login]` not `user[email]` (authentication_keys: [:login]). Let me check the form and retry:

reasoning_content:
This looks standard. The user is being found, and the password is valid too. So why is the login failing?

Wait a minute... maybe the login form is posting `user[login]` instead of `user[email]`! In this fork, `authentication_keys: [:login]` is set. I sent `user[email]=...`, but that doesn't match the `login` key. Let me check the sign-in form.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "login\|email" app/views/users/shared/_login_fields.html.erb 2>/dev/null | head; ls app/views/users/shared/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rln "login" app/views/users/ | head
